bioEn:
Julien Ramirez is a cinematographer born in Belgium, he studied cinematography at INSAS school in Brussels. He graduated in 2016. Based in Brussels, he works as a cinematographer for narrative as well as commercials and music videos. 
He recently shot Conjuring 5 directed by Rodrigue Huart in USA.
